source.text:
Location: Tbilisi, Georgia (UTC+4)

Remote: Yes, remote only. I can overlap with US East mornings and with Europe.

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: Swift 6, SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, iOS, macOS, watchOS, HealthKit, StoreKit 2, Core ML, WhisperKit, OpenAI Responses API with function calling, MCP. Supabase/Postgres for the backend side.

Résumé/CV: https://www.linkedin.com/in/voltec366 | https://github.com/voltec | https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/voltec

Email: voltec366@gmail.com

Senior iOS and macOS engineer, 14 years. Contract or full-time.

I want to build AI features for apps: the client side in iOS or macOS and the backend around it, with Supabase and Postgres on the server. A startup that needs its first iOS engineer fits too.

At SHRED, a fitness app with 2.7M users, I built the Apple Watch app from scratch, the live video classes and a video editor, shipped key features of the main app and modernized its Objective-C code.

At StreamLayer I took features from design to release in their iOS SDK for sports-streaming apps: chat, predictions, polls, trivia, leaderboards, in-stream video calls, a live feed. Chat and predictions served up to 30,000 viewers at once.

Tempo, an AI health coach, runs on a HealthKit engine and an OpenAI function-calling layer I built.

Aide, a macOS meeting assistant, is mine end to end: it records system audio, transcribes on-device with WhisperKit, calls tools over MCP and searches across past meetings and chats.

I can take a whole product under my wing and run its development and releases. On several production apps I was the only iOS engineer, owning the architecture, App Store releases, feature flags and gradual rollouts. I invoice through my own sole proprietorship in Georgia.

In the App Store: SHRED https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shred-gym-home-workouts/id1439... | Tempo https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tempo-ai-health-assistant/id67... | AideAI for Mac https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aideai-personal-ai-assistant/i...
